THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION - AUGUST 2026
Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 162,000 in August, and the
unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1 percent. Average hourly earnings
increased 0.3 percent over the month. The change in total nonfarm payroll
employment for July was revised from 100,000 to 110,000.
